testCase.name: [本地] S22 A browser with the wrong date and time zone: Save Note's 'today' labels follow the server (web half)

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S08, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S22 「日期和时区错了的浏览器：Save Note 的「今天」标签跟着服务器（网页那一半）」 A browser with the wrong date and time zone: Save Note's 'today' labels follow the server (web half)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 Time rules that Save Note touches ('today' on the course line, today's vitals/labs column, the 12 h window) use the server clock; …（UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Local stack (http://localhost:6473) and a make-session-style @roundai.test account; two Playwright browser contexts on the same patient and resident: one correct, one with page.clock.setFixedTime(server now + 2 days) and timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu'

When Save Note the S01 text (Hospital) and the S02 text (Nursing Home) from the shifted context, then read the chart and compare with what the correct context writes

Then The course line's day label and today's vitals/labs column (vitalsHistory date, Nursing Home vitalsDate) carry the server's date, the same as from the correct context

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions against 3.8: day label and dates equal the server-clock values. Code read predicts a Fail: todayLabel() and new Date().toDateString() in both hooks, and preRoundVintageTag in src/domain/noteContext.ts, use the device clock; the day roll part is known: TFA-92584. The phone half is S04

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 无（只在 UAT）

设备时钟快两天时，Save Note 把今天的生命体征和化验记在设备日期下（服务器是 10/14，却出现 10/15 的一列），而病程那一行用的是服务器日期。

On a device whose clock is two days ahead, Save Note files today's vitals and labs under the device's date (a column for Oct 15 while the server says Oct 14). The same Save Note dates the course line by the server.

依据：allure ac2766b7, Playwright context shifted to Pacific/Honolulu +2 days. The vitals/labs column and the NH vitalsDate read 'Thu Oct 15 2026'; a correct device gives Wed Oct 14. Cause: new Date().toDateString() in usePreRoundProcess.ts:193 and useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts:191. This breaks UAT 3.8 (TC-10 U12, which has no gate ticket). TC-10 risks predicted it, but it is not in the dev report, the ledger or any knownGaps. OAT-04 K10 covers the same browser-clock class for retention stamps (TFA-94699 AC 7, in progress), the likely home for a fix. The course-line time-zone part is TC-11 Q4, already recorded.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S22

A browser with the wrong date and time zone: Save Note's 'today' labels follow the server (web half)

Tickets: none (UAT only)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题；另有一部分是已知缺口））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium spec, fresh account: a correct context and one with the device clock +2 days and timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu (page.clock.install); Save Note with the parse answered at the socket (fixed values). Before pressing Save the spec waits for the app's own server-time ask (time:now mutation, recorded at the socket) to be answered, as it would be while a physician types; the ask's result is recorded. Assert the course line's day label, today's vitalsHistory/labsHistory date and NH vitalsDate equal the server's day (either time zone accepted, TC-11 Q4). — Device clock and time zone are browser-context settings; the server-time answer is observed on the sync socket.

Detail:

Re-run 17:26 after a test fix: the spec now waits for the app's own server-time ask (time:now, src/data/time.ts) to be answered before pressing Save Note — it answered 0.55–0.72 s after the page load, success, in both contexts. Why: in the 17:07 re-run the spec typed with fill() and pressed Save before that answer, so the Nursing Home course line also carried the device's day ('Visit 1 · Oct 15'); the app reads the device clock until the server answers, and no physician types a pre-round note in 0.6 s, so that was a test artifact (recorded, not judged). With the answer in: course line 'Oct 13: …' / 'Visit 1 · Oct 13: …' = the server's day read in Honolulu (time-zone part recorded, TC-11 Q4); correct device 'Oct 14'. Fails: today's vitals and labs columns 'Thu Oct 15 2026' and Nursing Home vitalsDate 'Thu Oct 15 2026' (the device's day; correct device: Wed Oct 14 2026). Parse answered at the socket with fixed values.

产品问题：known: open PR #100 (TFA-92592), not on main — commit 0b738c0 'a value's day is read on the corrected clock' switches usePreRoundProcess / useSnfPreRoundProcess 'today' from new Date() to clockNow(); .agents/qa-project-context.md lists '#100 dated vitals/labs' under open PRs. On main: a device two days ahead files today's vitals and labs under the device's date (a column for a day that has not happened), while the same Save Note dates the course line by the server. Breaks TC-10 U12 (UAT 3.8). Re-check when #100 merges.

已知缺口（known）：PR #100 (TFA-92592), not on main

证据：附了 4 个；没附 1 个：

  • newspec-b/rerun-fix2-tc10-s22.log — .log 文件不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our chromium spec, not written yet): two Playwright contexts with page.clock and timezoneId on a fresh @roundai.test account made with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
